content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["Animations and drawing style are horrible, with lazily drawn 2D backdrops and 3D sprites that feel reversed from realistic CGI movies.", "Writing appears childish, as if done by a group of 8‑year‑old boys, lacking humor and depth.", "Humor focuses on body‑shaming, animal abuse, and anti‑gay propaganda, delivered poorly.", "The film includes absurd travel times (14 days to the moon, 23 days to Saturn) that are briefly acknowledged but not convincingly explained.", "The Saturn sequence is described as a hot beach party with only hot women attracted to a geeky guy, which the reviewer finds off‑putting."]}
